messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync on ACME POC. They want a 2-week sandbox for search+rerank+light gen. Need sample data guidance, redaction rules, connectivity, and success criteria. Can we align?

devon_se: Clarify: embeddings + rerank + small assistant? QPS/latency targets?

maria_sales: Yes. ACME: embeddings + rerank + follow-up gen. Peak ~8 QPS, target median gen latency ~200ms.

alex_eng: Recommend presigned S3 + IAM-scoped creds for trial. Private/VPC only if they require network isolation (longer lead).

sarah_cs: Proposed success criteria: 1) retrieval precision >=0.7 on our eval set, 2) median gen latency <200ms at 8 QPS, 3) zero PII leaks on eval prompts. I'll own eval runs.

maria_sales: Legal flagged DPA + security questionnaire. Do we need explicit approval if samples contain PII?

legal-bot: Legal: need dataflow diagram and redaction rules before DPA. Real PII requires retention policy and sign-off.

devon_se: Evals: ~20 retrieval prompts, ~15 gen prompts, plus small PII membership set. Sizing note: hosted GPUs ok for 2 weeks; recommend equivalent g4dn.12xlarge for Dedicated to hit latency.

alex_eng: Redaction snippet we can provide:
```
python redact.py --input sample.csv --fields email,ssn,phone --mode mask --out sanitized.csv
```
We can seed a 5k-row sanitized sample + ingest notebook. If they insist on production data, require checklist+DPA+ops review.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-4821 opened: temp S3 bucket + presigned upload, IAM role limited to bucket, short-lived creds. ETA 2 business days.

devon_se: Pricing: for a 2-week Dedicated pilot finance review needed; can offer pilot credits/discounted short commit. Will follow up offline.

sarah_cs: I'll script automated checks: precision/recall, latency histograms, and PII detection on outputs after ingest.

maria_sales: Action items:
- maria_sales: request sample schema + attach security questionnaire to ACME.
- alex_eng: prepare sanitized sample, redact script, ingest notebook.
- devon_se: sizing recommendation + pilot cost estimate.
- infra-bot: follow INF-4821 provisioning.
- legal-bot: validate redaction rules and DPA.

alex_eng: I'll send sanitized sample and presigned upload instructions to ACME today.

devon_se: Note: if they need >2k token contexts call out quantized model variant in handoff.

maria_sales: Thanks — updating acct exec and ACME PM. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
